sentences.text: It is further alleged that on 22.11.2023 the informant verified from his phone and saw message that the amount of Rs.20,000/- was deposited in his account and on verifying the current balance, he found his account was showing total balance of Rs.729/- and thereafter he realized that the persons have used his phone and withdrawn the said amount.
On the basis of said report, police have registered the crime.
3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as the present applicant is concerned, his name is not mentioned in the FIR.
It is alleged against the present applicant that he was asked by the co-accused to collect the ten persons.
Accordingly, he collected.
As far as the economic gain is concerned, which is not in favour of the present applicant.
On the contrary, the present applicant is one of the victim at the hands of the co-accused.
His immediate custody is not required and he be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

Learned APP strongly opposed the application on the ground that there is a specific role attributed to the present applicant within the investigation, as the list of 56 persons was revealed from the mobile phone of the present applicant,
therefore, his custodial interrogation is required.
5. I have perused the recitals of the FIR and the order passed by the trial Court nowhere discloses the specific role attributed to the present applicant.
The offence alleged are punishable with less than seven years imprisonment.

In view of the guidelines issued by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 Livelaw (SC) 577.
The Investigation Officer has to satisfy himself regarding the assigning the reasons behind the arrest of the applicant.

ORDER (i) In the event of the arrest, in connection with Crime No.1049/2023 registered with Police Station Saoner, District (4) 9.aba.125.2024 Nagpur for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468,
471, 413 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66 of the Information of Technology Act, the applicant Vikas s/o Dhanraj Khudale be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail, on execution PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station once in a week on Sunday between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate the investigating agency.
(iii) The applicant shall not induce, threat or promise any witnesses who are acquainted with the facts of the case.

(iv) The Investigation Officer shall issue the notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. to the present applicant and shall record the reason why the arrest of the present applicant is required.
Stand over after two weeks.
